title.narrative: Improvement of Water supply and Health facilities in Kassala and Red Sea States, Sudan

description.narrative: This project will implement three components in Port Sudan and Kassala to address the current dire needs limiting access to health care and water, including water provision through the construction and provision of pumping stations and transmission lines, water distribution network, and procuring equipment for ensuring water quality and hygiene; as well as health services strengthening through rehabilitation of hospitals and procurement of medical equipment; and institutional capacity building.
